title: Mid-Market Account Executive DACH (m/w/d)
description:
Wir bei SoSafe haben das Ziel, der führende Anbieter für Human Risk Management Lösungen in Europa zu werden. Unsere preisgekrönte Awareness-Plattform unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, nachhaltige Verhaltensänderungen durch effektive, interaktive Trainings rund um Cyber-Sicherheit und Datenschutz zu erzielen. Cyberkriminalität kostet die Welt jährlich >$10 Billionen, mit steigenden Kosten um 15 % pro Jahr - werde Teil der Lösung und gestalte die Zukunft der Cybersicherheit aktiv mit!

Als Mid-Market Account Executive (m/w/d) wirst du Teil eines dynamischen, ambitionierten und internationalen Teams von Account Executives, das auf Zusammenarbeit, täglichen Wissensaustausch und die kontinuierliche Optimierung von Vertriebsprozessen setzt. Erfolg treibt uns an - und mit unserer offenen, motivierenden Teamkultur macht das Erreichen von Zielen gleich doppelt so viel Freude!

Gemeinsam mit dem Sales Development Representative (SDR) Team baust du täglich dein Kundennetzwerk aus und übertriffst deine Ziele. Du verstehst die Herausforderungen und Bedürfnisse deiner Kunden und weißt, wie du unser Cybersecurity-Angebot positionierst und eine Lösung präsentierst, auf die deine Kunden nicht verzichten können!

Teamwork ist entscheidend - du arbeitest eng mit internen Teams wie Pre-Sales, Customer Success und Partner Managern zusammen, um ein reibungsloses und wirkungsvolles Kundenerlebnis zu gewährleisten. Deine Fähigkeit, Abschlüsse zu erzielen und neue Geschäftsfelder voranzutreiben, ist entscheidend für deinen Erfolg und dein Wachstum in dieser Rolle.

SO TRÄGST DU ZUM ERFOLG BEI:

- Akquise neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten im Mid-Market, Public-Segment.

- Eigenverantwortliches Management des gesamten Sales-Zyklus - von der ersten

Ansprache bis zum Vertragsabschluss - mit dem Ziel, neue Kunden zu gewinnen und

deine Vertriebsziele zu erreichen.

- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit SDRs zur Identifikation und Qualifizierung von Leads und zur

Sicherstellung einer stabilen Sales-Pipeline.

- Steuerung, Verhandlung und Abschluss von Cross- und Upselling-Möglichkeiten in

enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Customer Success Managern.

- Aufbau und Pflege nachhaltiger Beziehungen zu Entscheidungsträgern potenzieller

Kunden, um den Mehrwert der SoSafe-Cybersecurity-Lösungen überzeugend zu

präsentieren.

- Durchführung von Online-Demos, Vor-Ort-Terminen und Events zur Präsentation

unseres innovativen Produkts und zur Stärkung des Kundengeschäfts.

WAS DICH AUSZEICHNET:

- 2-4 Jahre Erfahrung in einer Closing-Rolle im SaaS-Vertrieb, idealerweise mit Fokus

auf SMB- oder Mid-Market-Kunden im öffentlichen Sektor.

- Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Ownership - du übernimmst die Initiative, behältst

Ziele im Blick und bringst Deals mit Disziplin und Konsequenz zum Abschluss.

- Ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit und Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit cross-

funktionalen Teams.

- Proaktivität und Eigeninitiative mit der Fähigkeit, selbstständig zu arbeiten.

- Anpassungsfähig und in der Lage, Prioritäten in einem dynamischen Start-up-Umfeld

flexibel zu managen.

- Offen für Feedback und Bereitschaft, kontinuierlich zu lernen und dich

weiterzuentwickeln.

- Bereitschaft zur Arbeit im hybriden Modell - mit Anwesenheitstagen im Büro

sowie Remote-Tagen.

- Erfahrung mit CRM-Tools (z. B. Salesforce, HubSpot), Prospecting-Software und

LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

- Fließende Deutsch und Englisch- Kenntnisse werden vorausgesetzt.

WAS WIR BIETEN*:

- Work-Life-Balance: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, 33 Tage Urlaub und zusätzliche finanzielle Unterstützung während der Elternzeit

- Well-being und finanzielle Unterstützung: Zugang zur Open-Up App, Mitarbeiterrabatte, sowie Wellbeing & Fitness Benefits mit Urban Sports Club

- Verbindung & Gemeinschaft: Virtuelle Events, gemeinsame Teamaktivitäten und Möglichkeiten für lokale Treffen

- Und vieles mehr: Technische Ausstattung, Empfehlungsprämien, ein individuelles Weiterbildungsbudget, hundefreundliches Büro

title: Junior Product Owner
description:
JOIN OUR TEAM AS A JUNIOR PRODUCT OWNER AT HAWK-EYE INNOVATIONS

Hi, I’m Alison Marr, Product Lead for the Tracking and Auto Officiating Value Stream at Hawk-Eye Innovations. Are you interested in working with the latest technologies in a fast-paced environment, with exciting career opportunities in a growing business?

At Hawk-Eye, we build technology that powers some of the most exciting and critical moments in sport, from instant replays and broadcast augmentation to officiating systems trusted by leagues, federations, broadcasters, and millions of fans worldwide.

Our Value Stream delivers the tracking and automatic officiating services that have revolutionised global sport. From our world-renowned ball and object tracking systems to SkeleTRACK, our real-time skeletal tracking services, we turn live athletic movement into precise, high-stakes decisions and elite data insights.

We are looking for a Junior Product Owner to help drive our tracking and automated officiating products forward. In this role, you will bridge the gap between technical execution and operational excellence. You will keep the technical depth and operational focus of an engineer while taking structured ownership of backlog definition, prioritisation, and delivery outcomes. Working across complex, real-time software-hardware integrated systems in live stadium and broadcast environments, you will directly impact how our world-leading tracking platforms perform on the global stage.

What You'll Be Doing

- Product Definition & Backlog Ownership: Act as the voice of users, operators, and the business. Translate needs into epics, features, and user stories for small-to-medium changes, and maintain a prioritised backlog using data, value, and risk.

- Quality & Testing Coordination: Define and coordinate QC activities (functional, integration, regression, and UAT). Lead defect detection, triage, validation, and root cause investigations to ensure our tracking systems remain incredibly accurate and reliable.

- Cross-Functional Delivery: Work day-to-day with Engineering, QA, TechOps, and UX teams to align on scope. Participate fully in Agile ceremonies, monitor support channels, and coordinate third-line support within your scope.

- Deployment & Early-Life Support: Create and maintain documentation, runbooks, and training materials. Support pilots, staged roll-outs, and early-life support until tracking products are smoothly embedded in live, real-time match operations.

- Growth Toward Level 4: Build your capabilities across the full product lifecycle. With coaching from senior POs and Product Managers, you will begin shaping short-range roadmaps, defining OKRs, and handling increasing ambiguity.

What We're Looking For

- 1-3 years of experience in a product-related role (e.g., Associate Product Owner, Business Analyst, QA, Operator, or similar) working on technically complex products.

- Strong technical grounding with the ability to communicate effectively with engineers, QA, and operators across software-hardware integrated systems.

- Proven experience coordinating QC/regression testing and managing defect resolution.

- Data & Cloud Comfort: Experience working with cloud-based and data-oriented products, with the ability to interpret basic product analytics and operational telemetry.

- Excellent communication skills and a proactive mindset to plan your own work, handle ambiguity, and escalate risks appropriately.

Bonus Points For

- Experience supporting product launches and creating documentation or tutorial content.

- Exposure to stakeholder engagement, prioritisation frameworks, and roadmap contribution.

- Experience working with products that combine software, high-performance cameras, and hardware in high-pressure, live broadcast, or real-time sports environments.

Benefits & Perks

- Annual leave per local labour law

- Hybrid working (2 days/week in office)

- Sony Group perks - discounted tickets and events

- Cafeteria options (SZÉP Card

title: Senior Solutions Architect, Higher Education and Research, Multimodal and Physic
description:
NVIDIA has been redefining computer graphics and accelerated computing for three decades. Today, we are tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. Doing what has never been done before takes vision, innovation, and exceptional talent. As an NVIDIA N, you will be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is encouraged to do their best work and make a lasting impact on the world.
We are looking for a Solutions Architect in the Greater London area to work with academia and research partners. Solutions Architects are the primary technical contacts for our customers and engage deeply with researchers and application developers to drive the adoption of NVIDIA technology. We seek an individual who combines an intricate understanding of Multimodal AI and Physical AI with expertise in accelerated computing and architecture.
What you will be doing:

• Partner directly with leading research labs, researchers, and university faculty as a trusted technical advisor: develop a keen understanding of their scientific goals and drive joint research projects at supercomputing scale.

• Identify and accelerate high-impact workloads by integrating NVIDIA 's frameworks, libraries, and core software stack into research projects, and help researchers amplify their impact through publications, conference presentations, and technical content.

• Advocate for accelerated computing, robotics, Multimodal AI and Physical AI, and deliver hands-on trainings, workshops, lectures and demonstrations across NVIDIA 's platforms, and mentor power users to become NVIDIA champions.

• Track emerging research trends and turn gaps between researcher needs and NVIDIA 's offerings into prototypical solutions and direct feedback to NVIDIA Engineering.

• Maintain deep expertise in your domain while staying versatile across NVIDIA 's full platform: GPUs, CPUs, networking, and software

What we need to see:

• A graduate degree from a leading university in a STEM related discipline.

• 5+ years in the multimodal and world model lifecycle on multi-node GPU systems: video and image data curation at scale, pre-training and post-training, evaluation, and efficient inference.

• Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to build relationships with academic and research stakeholders, and to communicate complex ideas clearly to both expert and non-expert audiences.

• Action oriented, analytical, self-motivated, and a passionate learner, with excellent organization skills to work in a heavily multi-tasked environment.

• Fluent in English, both oral and written, and comfortable working in Python.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• A PhD from a leading university in a STEM related discipline, with 3+ years of research in the domain.

• A track record of thought leadership: high-impact publications, talks at academic conferences and workshops, as well as good understanding of scientific policy engagement, grant processes, or national/European research program structures.

• Experience with NVIDIA 's stack for visual and multimodal AI, built on CUDA and CUDA-X, including Cosmos world foundation models, NeMo Framework and Megatron for multimodal model training, multimodal Nemotron methodology, Isaac robotics platform, NuRec for neural reconstruction, TensorRT and NIM for deployment, and domain frameworks such as MONAI for medical imaging.

As a Solutions Architect, there is travel involved, as often the best way to figure things out is a face-toface meeting, but the job is not life on the road. We make heavy use of conferencing tools, and you are empowered to figure out how to get the job done and do what it takes to make our customers successful.

description:
Job Title : TikTok Shop Manager
Role : Full-Time
Location : Remote
Core Hours: 8am - 2pm PST
Salary Range: $700 - $900
ABOUT THE ROLE
As TikTok Shop Manager, you will be responsible for building our client's TikTok Shop from the ground up and managing it on an ongoing basis. You will handle everything from initial account registration and product catalog setup through to daily order operations, ad campaign management, affiliate program oversight, and monthly performance reporting. The ideal candidate has operated a high-volume TikTok Shop end-to-end and is comfortable navigating the full Seller Center toolkit.
PHASE 1 RESPONSIBILITIES - SHOP SETUP & CONFIGURATION
Shop Profile & Branding

• Configure shop name, logo, banner imagery, categories, and storefront layout in Seller Center

• Write a compelling, keyword-rich shop bio and description

• Link the TikTok Business/Marketing Account(s) to the shop to enable shoppable video and product tagging

Product Catalog Setup

• Audit the product range against TikTok's prohibited and restricted product policies and advise the client

• List products individually or via bulk upload / Shopify catalog sync

• Optimize product titles with niche search keywords, write detailed descriptions, and upload multi-angle imagery and demo videos

• Understand and discuss with the client (and then implement) the optimal configuration for SKUs, variants, and pricing; set opening inventory levels

• Submit all listings for TikTok product approval review and resolve any rejections

• Conduct a test purchase to validate the full checkout and fulfillment flow

FBM and FBT Configuration

• Configure FBM: Set warehouse / pickup and return addresses; create shipping templates covering rates, zones, and carrier selection

• Configure FBT: enroll products, prepare inbound shipments to TikTok warehouses, and configure the free-shipping opt-in settings

• If using Shopify: install and configure the TikTok channel app to enable real-time inventory and order sync

• Author and publish the shop's return policy in compliance with applicable consumer protection laws

• Draft 3PL to FBT ongoing inventory management plan and workflow.

Customer Service

• Configure customer service notifications

• Set up FAQs, saved responses, and response workflows

• Establish return, refund, and cancellation handling procedures

• Set escalation path for customer support issues

Advertising & Promotions Setup

• Link TikTok Ads Manager to the shop and configure the primary ad account

• Launch initial GMV Max campaign(s) - set target ROI, daily budget, and product selection

• Set up TikTok Search Ads with relevant keyword targeting to capture intent-driven discovery

• Configure TikTok Pixel if driving traffic to an external website or landing page

• Build out and maintain welcome promotions, platform coupons, and launch discount strategies in Seller Center

Affiliate / Creator Program Setup

• Enable and configure the Affiliate Center, including open and targeted collaboration plans

• Work with our Affiliate/Creator team to set baseline and tiered commission structures across product categories

• Work with our Affiliate/Creator team to establish a product seeding / free sample program and write a creator brief with content guidelines

PHASE 2 RESPONSIBILITIES - ONGOING MANAGEMENT & OPERATIONS
Daily Operations

• Monitor and respond to all buyer messages within 12 hours

• Verify the processing and fulfillment of new orders

• Review and action open return and refund requests in line with shop policy

• Monitor product and video comments for customer questions, complaints, or escalations

• Check the Shop Health dashboard daily for violations, warnings, or Late Dispatch Rate (LDR) increases

Weekly Operations

• Review GMV Max campaign performance (cost, orders, CPA, ROI) and adjust target ROI as needed

• Audit GMV Max creative assets and exclude under-performing videos

• Review inventory levels and initiate restock for SKU

title: Level 1 Support Technician
locationText: Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, New Zealand, United Kingdom, United States
description:
No, 'have you tried turning it off and on again?' is not beneath you here - it's literally step one...
We're looking for a Tier 1 Help Desk Specialist who combines a great attitude with a genuine passion for helping people. This is an entry-level role with constant client interaction, supporting small to mid-sized businesses and keeping their technology running smoothly.
They are a growing Managed Services Provider known for their responsive, people-first approach to IT support. Their clients count on them not just for technical fixes, but for a team that communicates clearly and treats every issue with care.
Attitude and customer service come first. Technical skills and tools can be taught - what matters most is genuinely enjoying helping people, staying calm under pressure, and bringing a strong work ethic. Don't have experience with the exact software listed below? Apply anyway! The one thing we really need is some prior experience in a support/helpdesk role.
📍 Fully remote | 3-6 month contract, with the possibility of extending further.
Responsibilities

• Be the first point of contact for client issues via phone, email, and automated alerts.

• Triage tickets: identify the problem, assess severity, and escalate when needed.

• Keep clients updated throughout the resolution process - no one likes radio silence.

• Configure and deploy new workstations; migrate data and applications.

• Troubleshoot Windows PCs, servers, and common hardware issues.

• Support Active Directory, DNS, file/folder security, print servers, and certificates.

• Monitor and troubleshoot client LAN environments.

• Assist with endpoint security (BitDefender, Blackpoint) and email management (OpenText/AppRiver).

• Document everything in IT Glue - seriously, everything.

Requirements

• 6 months to 1.5 years of experience in a helpdesk or IT support role, ideally at an MSP or in a role supporting multiple clients simultaneously.

• Native English speaker - this is a deal breaker. You'll be on the phone with clients daily and need to communicate clearly and professionally at all times.

• Available to work Monday-Friday, 8 am-5 pm US Central Time.

• Proven experience communicating with customers across multiple platforms (phone, email, ticketing systems).

• Hands-on experience with RMM, PSA/ticketing, and documentation platforms (we use NinjaOne, Autotask, and IT Glue).

• Windows OS experience in Workgroup and Domain environments; ability to set up PCs and migrate data.

• Working knowledge of Office 365, Adobe, and common Windows apps.

• Endpoint security and antivirus experience (BitDefender preferred).

• Familiarity with email management platforms like OpenText (AppRiver).

• Hardware troubleshooting at the subassembly level (hard drives, power supplies, GPUs, etc.).

• Windows Server: Active Directory, DNS, file/folder security, certificates, and print servers.

• Virus removal, spam mitigation, and LAN troubleshooting.

title: Senior Compliance Specialist
description:
Interested in joining a growing company where you will work with talented colleagues, enhance a supportive and energetic culture, and be part of the climate solution? At Energy Solutions , we focus on the big impacts. And we believe that market-based programs can be a powerful force to deliver large-scale energy, carbon, and water-use savings. Since 1995, we’ve harnessed that power to offer proven, performance-based solutions for our utility, government, and institutional customers.

Energy Solutions is seeking a Senior Compliance Specialist who will analyze, assess, and coordinate compliance with complex regulatory, contractual, privacy, audit, operational, data security, ethics, and risk management requirements under the direction of the General Counsel and Assistant General Counsel. This non-attorney role identifies compliance obligations, evaluates business risks, and recommends practical compliance solutions for legal review and business implementation.
In this role, the Senior Compliance Specialist will be operating with a high degree of independence, conduct risk assessments, interpret contractual and regulatory requirements, support audit and governance activities, and serve as a key compliance resource across the organization. Additionally, this person will collaborate with business units, project teams, Information Security, People and Culture, Finance, and external stakeholders to support compliance with contractual obligations, privacy requirements, regulatory requirements, audit expectations, and organizational policies.
This is a perfect opportunity for someone with strong analytical judgment, critical thinking, communication, and problem-solving skills, along with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

• Facilitate Energy Solutions ' compliance and ethics program in alignment with regulatory requirements, contractual obligations, and organizational standards.

• Conduct compliance assessments and monitoring activities to identify potential risks, control gaps, and compliance concerns.

• Analyze regulatory requirements, contractual obligations and changes, audit provisions, client flow-down requirements, and operational commitments to determine compliance obligations.

• Support privacy compliance activities, including ensuring compliance with California privacy requirements and other applicable privacy regulations, and responding to consumer privacy requests.

• Conduct preliminary assessments of security events and privacy incidents, support the Company’s response, and escalate legal interpretation questions to counsel, as needed.

• Prepare regulatory filings, compliance reports, and audit-related documentation.

• Assess contractual insurance requirements and coordinate company insurance coverage, renewals, certificates, and supporting documentation.

• Develop and maintain compliance-related policies, procedures, guidance documents, and operational controls.

• Support due diligence reviews, client questionnaires, proposal activities, and contractual compliance assessments.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in business administration, Legal Studies, Business Management, Public Policy, Risk Management, Project Management, Information Security, Compliance, or related field.

• 8 years of experience in contractual compliance, privacy laws, risk management, audit, legal operations, regulatory operations, governance, or related professional function.

• Experience interpreting and implementing regulatory, contractual, privacy, audit, or compliance requirements in a business environment.

• Experience conducting compliance assessments, risk analyses, monitoring activities, audits, remediation efforts, or operational reviews.

• Experience supporting privacy, data protection, contractual compliance, governance, or risk management programs.

• Experience facilitating compliance activities across multiple business functions

title: Senior Security Engineer - Sec Ops
description:
Are you a collaborative Sec Ops Engineer looking to work for a mission driven global organization?
About our Team
You’ll be joining the Security Engineering team within Elsevier ’s Information Security & Data Protection department. Our team designs, builds, and operates the security tooling and platforms used across Elsevier Technology, spanning both vendor platforms and team-built services. The team works closely with Incident Response, Threat Engineering, and Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC), and partners with business and engineering teams to ensure security tooling is effectively adopted across our cloud estate.
About the Role
As a Senior Security Engineer, you help lead in designing, building, and operating security tooling at scale, while raising the technical bar for the wider team. You will own architecture decisions for one or more platforms, guide junior and mid-level engineers through code and design review, and act as a trusted technical voice with Incident Response, Threat Engineering, and GRC. This role suits someone with deep, hands-on cloud security engineering experience who is ready to take ownership beyond individual delivery, shaping how the team builds and operates security tooling
Responsibilities

• Leading the design, architecture, and delivery of security platforms and services.

• Owning and evolve Infrastructure as Code standards (Terraform) and CI/CD practices (GitHub Actions) across the team, ensuring reliable, secure, and repeatable deployments.

• Providing technical leadership and mentorship to junior and mid-level engineers, including design review, code review, and guidance on secure engineering practices.

• Driving integration, tuning, and lifecycle management of core security tooling.

• Partnering with Incident Response, Threat Engineering, and GRC to translate emerging threats, incidents, and compliance requirements into engineering solutions and roadmap priorities.

• Championing adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to improve team velocity, code quality, and test coverage.

• Leading troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for security tooling incidents, and drive resilience improvements through capacity planning, disaster recovery planning, and runbook development.

• Representing SENG in architecture reviews and cross-functional technical forums, advocating for secure-by-design and secure-by-default practices.

• Delivering production-ready systems on time and within budget, and hold the team accountable to engineering and security standards.

Requirements
We recognize that no one will meet every requirement. If you are excited about this role and have relevant experience, we encourage you to apply.

• Significant hands-on experience in security engineering or a related field, including designing and operating cloud-native security platforms at production scale.

• Demonstrated ownership of security architecture in AWS (or OCI/Aliyun), including multi-account environments and cross-region/CN considerations.

• Advanced proficiency with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code practices, with experience setting standards and patterns for a team.

• Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions) for reliability and security.

• Broad, hands-on experience across security tool categories: SIEM, EDR, DLP, PAM, WAF, SOAR, and vulnerability management,

• Proven track record mentoring engineers and leading technical design decisions within a team.

• Advanced scripting and software development skills (e.g. Python), including experience building and operating production services (APIs, cronjobs) on Kubernetes/EKS.

• Practical experience with AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Spec-driven development) and sound judgment on where they add the most value.

• Experience with Agile and/or DevOps frameworks, including driving improvements to team process and delivery practices.

U.S. National Base

description:

• Utilize our advanced collaboration portal to connect with students, providing them with the support they need.

About the Role

We're hiring a GRC Specialist (Governance, Risk and Compliance) to strengthen our compliance function as Secfix scales into more frameworks, mid-market customers, and a growing compliance team.

This role sits at the intersection of compliance delivery, content, and team support. You'll own the compliance knowledge that lives inside our platform, run internal audits, support our customer success team, and act as the compliance voice for customers, auditors, and product.

You'll work closely with our co-founder & CISO and our CS Lead. This is a high-impact role with real influence on how Secfix delivers compliance: both as a service to customers and as content inside our app.

- Collaborate closely with CS, Product, and Founders to align compliance, customer, and roadmap priorities

- Deepen relationships with our existing certification partners and train auditors on the Secfix platform so they can confidently use it during customer audits

To be qualified for this role, you must have the following:

- English (fluent) is a must for this role

- 3+ years of hands‑on information security and GRC experience

- Led at least 1 successful ISO 27001 certification projects as an implementer and/or auditor at a startup or mid-market company

- Hands on experience with a GRC platform like Secfix, or similar GRC platforms

- Real depth in at least one framework beyond ISO 27001 (TISAX, SOC 2, GDPR, NIS2, or similar).

- Strong project management skills with the ability to break down ambiguous initiatives into concrete deliverables, prioritizes ruthlessly, and ships

- Excellent written communication, especially in producing clear, precise compliance content for diverse audiences (auditors, founders, engineers)

Anduril's Air Dominance & Strike (AD&S) Manufacturing Engineering team is seeking a Senior DFx Engineer to drive design for manufacturability, assembly, and cost across our mechanical, structural, thermal management, and fluid systems (fuel, hydraulics, pneumatics) subsystems. This role spans our full portfolio of autonomous aircraft, cruise missiles, and loitering munitions - ensuring that design decisions account for how hardware will be built, by whom, and at what cost.
You will bring specialty expertise in at least one of the following domains: mechanical structures and assemblies, thermal/heat transfer systems, or fluid systems including fuel, hydraulic, and pneumatic architectures. • Support the selection and qualification of contract manufacturers for machined components, fabrications, composite structures, thermal hardware, and fluid system assemblies - assessing supplier manufacturing capability, process maturity, and cost competitiveness against DFx requirements.

• Participate in supplier manufacturing assessments including facility reviews, process audits, and capability evaluations.

• Contribute to should-cost models and cost-driver analyses for mechanical and fluid system assemblies, identifying design changes that reduce unit cost without compromising quality or performance.

title: Software Engineer

CI/CD has been solved. Now it's being reinvented. AI agents don't just run pipelines. They write code, trigger builds, interpret failures, and propose fixes. The interfaces that developers use to understand and trust that work don't exist yet. We're building them.

We think like the customer: every decision connects back to the developer sitting in front of a failing build at 2 am. We own the outcome: not just our slice of it, but the whole thing. If that's how you already work, you'll fit here.

You might own the CI pipeline experience, deploy and release tooling, notification infrastructure, monetization flows, AI agent surfaces, or the foundational web platform. The through line across all of it is the same: full-stack ownership, a high bar for craft, and work that directly shapes how tens of thousands of developers experience CircleCI every day.

What You'll Do

• Build AI-natively. AI is how we work. It’s not a productivity layer on top of engineering, but the default starting point for how problems get approached and solved.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Staff Enterprise Architect, you will design and evolve how GitLab's internal systems are configured, integrate, perform and scale to support a rapidly growing business. Reporting to the Director, Enterprise Architecture and AI Intelligent Automation, you will apply all four architecture lenses (business, application, data, and technology) to the systems in your scope, treating AI as a standing consideration inside each rather than a separate workstream.

Enterprise-wide strategy, portfolio direction, and standards ownership sit with the Director. What you'll do

Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!
Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.
Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.
BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.
Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.
Location
This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with occasional visits to customers across the DACH region.
As team collaboration is of great importance to us, we highly encourage team members to join us in Zurich at least once a month. These visits are financially supported by BLP.
About the role
For a process to run autonomously, four things have to line up: the technology, the process itself, the data behind it, and the people who work with it. That alignment does not happen at go-live. It happens in the months after, and that is where this role sits.
Our customers go live with a working solution. What they do not have on day one is an organisation that operates in an AI-native way. Processes were designed around people checking things. Data was maintained well enough for humans to interpret. Teams know the old workarounds better than the new system. Your job is to lead that transition, from a process that is automated in parts to a process that genuinely runs on its own.
That means working across every level of the customer's organisation. With operational teams you build understanding and find where automation is actually blocked. With department leads you challenge the process rules that make full automation impossible, and drive the decisions that change them. And you use the right lever for each blocker, because they are all different: some are a data clean-up you coordinate with the customer, some are a training and adoption gap, some need a custom agent, and some are structural and belong with our engineering teams.
You do not do this alone. You enable the customer's core team to solve their own issues, you work with our Customer Success Engineers on the technical side, and you use the Customer Success Manager to get decisions made where you need commercial weight. For our smaller customers, where there is no Customer Success Manager, you are the escalation point yourself.
You own customer health. Your sharpest measure of it is the automation rate.
What you'll do

• Own customer health across your portfolio, measured first and foremost by automation rates.

• Lead the transition to AI-native ways of working: identify what blocks automation, and pick the right way to solve each blocker.

• Work with operational teams on enablement and adoption, so people work efficiently with blp rather than around it.

• Challenge process rules that prevent automation, and drive improvements with the department leads who can decide.

• Coordinate data clean-up with the customer where master data quality is capping what automation can reach.

• Enable the customer's core team to resolve issues themselves, and reduce what has to come to us at all.

• Identify where a custom agent solves the problem, and where the issue is structural and belongs with ou

As Research Lead, Policy Communications, you will build and lead a rigorous research program that helps OpenAI understand how people engage with complex AI policy issues. title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Cloud-Native, AI-Driven Platform)
description:
We are building the next generation of AI-native software for the hospitality industry. Our platform powers complex, multi-tenant environments across multiple companies and product lines, operating in high-availability, high-performance scenarios.
Our systems handle critical operational workflows where uptime, scalability, and security are non-negotiable. As we evolve toward AI-native capabilities and intelligent automation, our infrastructure must be resilient, observable, and ready to scale dynamically.
We believe DevOps is not a support function - it is a core engineering discipline that enables product velocity, reliability, and innovation.
If you enjoy designing robust infrastructure, automating everything, and building platforms that engineers love to use, we’d love to meet you.
How You’ll Have Impact

•
Build the Platform Behind the Platform : Design and evolve the cloud infrastructure that powers our multi-tenant SaaS ecosystem.

•
Enable Engineering Velocity : Improve CI/CD pipelines, developer experience, and deployment automation.

•
Drive Reliability & Observability : Ensure high availability, performance, and real-time visibility across distributed systems.

•
Architect for Scale : Design infrastructure that supports growth, AI workloads, and distributed services.

•
Champion Infrastructure as Code : Everything reproducible, versioned, and automated.

•
Embed Security by Design : Implement DevSecOps best practices across the delivery lifecycle.

What You’ll Do

• Design, implement, and maintain cloud infrastructure in AWS and/or Azure .

• Manage and optimize containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes .

• Build and evolve CI/CD pipelines ( Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines, GitLab CI or equivalent).

• Implement Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar).

• Ensure high availability, disaster recovery, and backup strategies.

• Improve monitoring, logging, and alerting systems ( ELK stack , Grafana dashboards and alerting, Azure Monitor / Log Analytics, Amazon CloudWatch and other observability tools).

• Operate, monitor, and tune Microsoft SQL Server databases (performance, backups, high availability).

• Optimize system performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.

• Collaborate closely with backend engineers ( Java / Kotlin, C#, Node.js ) to improve deployment patterns and runtime reliability.

• Automate operational processes and reduce manual intervention.

• Leverage AI-assisted tooling ( Claude, Codex , automation agents, anomaly detection systems) to improve operational efficiency.

• Participate in architectural discussions to ensure infrastructure scalability and resilience.

You don’t just maintain infrastructure - you engineer the reliability of the business.
Cloud Building Blocks: AWS & Azure
We run workloads on both AWS and Azure . We are looking for solid hands-on experience with IaaS and core managed cloud services on at least one of them - knowing the equivalent on the other cloud is a strong plus. These are the building blocks you’ll work with:

•
Virtual machines & autoscaling - Azure: Azure Virtual Machines, VM Scale Sets | AWS: Amazon EC2, Auto Scaling Groups

•
Virtual networking - Azure: VNet, NSGs, VNet Integration, Private Endpoints | AWS: VPC, Security Groups, PrivateLink

•
L7 load balancing + WAF - Azure: Application Gateway + WAF | AWS: Application Load Balancer + AWS WAF

•
Web app / API hosting - Azure: App Service | AWS: Elastic Beanstalk / App Runner

•
Managed Kubernetes - Azure: AKS | AWS: EKS

•
Message queues - Azure: Azure Storage - Queues | AWS: Amazon SQS

•
Object storage - Azure: Azure Storage - Blobs | AWS: Amazon S3

•
In-memory cache - Azure: Azure Cache for Redis | AWS: Amazon ElastiCache (Redis / Valkey)

•
Managed SQL Server - Azure: Azure SQL / SQL Managed Instance | AWS: Amazon RDS for SQL Server

•
Workload identity (secretless auth) - Azure: Managed Identity + DefaultAzureCredential | AWS: IAM Roles (instance profiles, IRSA) + SDK defau

title: Senior Nuclear Criticality Safety Engineer
description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a Senior Nuclear Criticality Safety Engineer to join our team. 

Position Description

A Senior Nuclear Criticality Safety Engineer at Oklo is responsible for performing criticality safety evaluations, developing the nuclear criticality safety basis, and architecting the nuclear criticality safety program for a first-of-a-kind used nuclear fuel recycling facility.

Specific responsibilities may include:

• Identifying and evaluating nuclear criticality safety (NCS) hazards for fuel cycle facilities

• Performing criticality safety evaluations (CSEs) to demonstrate subcriticality under normal and credible abnormal conditions

• Developing the criticality code validation report

• Demonstrating compliance with the double-contingency principle

• Documenting criticality hazard analyses, CSEs, and supporting technical information

• Evaluating and implementing controlled parameters for the NCS program

• Developing the criticality accident alarm system and inadvertent criticality emergency response plan

• Supporting safety basis development and licensing efforts

• Developing and administering the NCS program, methodologies, and management measures

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelors, Masters, or PhD in nuclear engineering, chemical engineering, or chemistry, or related field

• Minimum 5+ years experience performing CSEs as a part of a nuclear facility’s safety basis

Bonus Qualifications:

• Knowledge of used nuclear fuel recycling technologies

• 10+ years of experience performing criticality safety evaluations for an NRC licensed fuel cycle facility

Competencies

We are looking for a Senior Nuclear Criticality Safety Engineer that is:

• Knowledge of nuclear science, physics of criticality, and chemistry

• Knowledge of nuclear fuel cycle processes and nuclear fuel cycle facility accident scenarios

• Proficient with Attila4MC, MCNP, SCALE, and/or Serpent codes and modules

• Familiarity with critical experiments and their purpose

• Knowledge of criticality-specific codes, standards, regulatory requirements, and industry practices for nuclear fuel cycle facilities

• Familiarity with NUREG-1513, NUREG-1520, NUREG/CR-6410, NUREG/CR-6698, NUREG/CR-7311, and NRC RG 3.71

• Passionate about clean energy and making advanced fission a reality

• Knowledgeable about structural design, analysis, and construction

• Eager to work on a dynamic team, receive constructive feedback, and grow with us

• Willing to think differently and learn quickly

• Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment

• Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving, while not leaning only on what has been done before 

• An excellent writer who can communicate technical concepts in modern active voice

Who you are:

A startup person : You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated : You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player : Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator : We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

title: Team Lead (m/w/d) Field Sales - Dortmund
description:
Möchtest du deine Sales-Fähigkeiten an andere weitergeben und für das Wachstum von Salonkee in [REGION] verantwortlich sein? Bei uns bekommst du ein strukturiertes Management-Onboarding, ein eigenes Team, das du weiter ausbaust, sowie Verantwortung und Vertrauen.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE:

- Team aufbauen und entwickeln: Du startest entweder als erstes Teammitglied oder mit einem kleinen Team, das du weiter ausbaust.

- Du entwickelst dein Team durch Coaching, Shadowing und Roleplays - nicht nur durch Steuerung & Monitoring.

- Lead by Example: In der Aufbauphase gewinnst du auch selbst Neukund:innen, mit einem klar definierten eigenen Zielanteil. So kennst du den Markt aus erster Hand.

- Präsenz im Markt: Du begleitest dein Team zu Terminen, unterstützt in der Akquise und überzeugst live in Demos.

- Du steuerst datenbasiert - über KPIs und Pipeline. Du kennst die Zahlen deiner Teammitglieder und leitest daraus frühzeitig Maßnahmen ab.

- Struktur und Rhythmus: Du organisierst die Woche, führst 1:1-Gespräche, löst Hindernisse schnell und sorgst für saubere Arbeit im CRM.

- Du entwickelst deine Region strategisch weiter und wirkst an der Optimierung unserer Vertriebsprozesse mit.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Vertrieb, davon nachweisbar im Außendienst (Field Sales) mit eigener Abschlussverantwortung.

- Nachweisbare Erfolge in der Neukundengewinnung: Du kannst mit Zahlen belegen, was du erreicht hast und woran du festmachst, dass du darin gut bist.

- Führungserfahrung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Wichtiger ist, dass du die Fähigkeiten hast, deine Teammitglieder zu entwickeln und für Wachstum zu sorgen. Relevante Erfahrungen in den Bereichen Mentoring, Onboarding neuer Kolleg:innen oder in Projekten sind hilfreich.

- Datenaffinität: Du arbeitest sicher mit KPIs, Pipeline und Forecast und leitest daraus Entscheidungen ab.

- Du bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du planst deine Region eigenständig und setzt klare Prioritäten.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Führungskräfte-Entwicklung von Tag 1: Unsere Sales Manager Academy begleitet dich beim Einstieg in die Führungsrolle - gerade dann, wenn es dein erstes Team ist.

- Echter Gestaltungsspielraum: Du entscheidest mit, wen du einstellst und wie dein Team arbeitet.

- Ein Vergütungspaket, das Team- und Eigenleistung honoriert: attraktives Fixum plus ungedeckelte Provision.

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Teamevents, die ihren Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Teamformate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

5. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

title: Principal Web Solutions Strategist
description:
About OHO

OHO is a digital agency full of smart, curious learners who love solving complex problems for higher education organizations. We partner with colleges and universities to navigate digital complexity so their marketing drives measurable impact for their brand and enrollment goals.
We bring deep expertise and a consultative mindset to everything we do-asking the right questions, challenging assumptions when needed, and always centering around our clients’ goals. In this role, you’ll be the subject-matter expert who frames the solution as part of the win-strategy for higher-ed web solutions engagements, helping prospective clients understand where they’re stuck and advising them on the right path forward, not just pitching a product.
We’re building toward a future where OHO is higher education’s most trusted advisory and implementation partner, and this role sits on the front lines of that journey-translating institutional challenges into smart, actionable web strategies.
About the Position
At its core, this role exists to win business: owning win-strategy, shaping the story OHO tells, engaging directly with clients, and leading pitches and proposals for Web Solutions deals.
The Principal Web Solutions Strategist sits on OHO ’s Web Solutions Strategy team and plays a critical role at the intersection of business development, strategy, and delivery, in close partnership with the Director of Strategy. This role leads the strategic definition of Web Solutions deals, from early conversations with prospective clients through high-level involvement during delivery-ensuring that what OHO sells is thoughtful, viable, and aligned with how we deliver value.
In the sales process, the Principal Web Solutions Strategist crafts and communicates the vision and then defines the solution. You will own the majority of strategic airtime in client conversations:

• Properly diagnosing client pain points and goals

• Leading pitches and proposal strategy

• Creating proposals and pitch materials, bringing in subject-matter experts and delivery leads when specialized input is needed or the opportunity requires a custom deliverable

• Presenting audits and strategic recommendations

• Clearly explaining OHO ’s approach and the “how” behind our work

Proposal and pitch work is core to this role. It’s strategic work, not just production work. You’ll set the direction and narrative, developing customized proposals and pitch materials that communicate a persuasive, tailored solution that meets the client’s needs while effectively communicating the value OHO would bring to the engagement.
You’ll work closely with OHO ’s Sales and Web Solutions teams, collecting collaborative input and feedback as you build the final proposal or pitch for delivery.
Through deep expertise in higher education websites and digital ecosystems, you’ll build trust quickly and confidently answer complex technical and strategic questions, partnering with OHO subject matter experts as needed.
After a project is won, you’ll stay engaged at key moments to ensure the project direction stays aligned with the vision established during the sales process. You’ll support a strong transition into delivery, participate in select milestones where your context is most valuable, and be available to help flag major strategic misalignments or risks so the team can address them early. This role provides continuity and confidence for the client at pivotal points while empowering the delivery team to lead day-to-day strategy and execution.
Beyond individual projects, you’ll help shape the evolution of OHO ’s Web Solutions practice. You’ll gather market insights, identify buyer patterns, and partner with our Web Solutions leadership team to shape, inform and refine our offerings and how we talk about the value we bring to potential partners. i You’ll also contribute to OHO ’s thought leadership so that OHO continues to be seen as a trusted strategic partner for higher education institutions.

Наші продукти активно зростають, а разом з ними зростає і наша команда. Ми працюємо за транзакційною моделлю монетизації, а наші продукти включають велику кількість social interactions, що створює безліч викликів і запитань до аналітики.

- Валідація продуктових гіпотез: продуктова команда генерує багато ідей, і твоя роль полягає в тому, щоб оцінити їх потенціал і правильно пріоритезувати.

- А/В-тестування: будеш супроводжувати тести повним циклом - від постановки гіпотези й дизайну експерименту до аналізу результатів і практичних рекомендацій бізнесу.

 - Будеш налаштовувати event-based аналітику для нового функціоналу та покращувати її на вже існуючому, щоб коректно оцінювати вплив на поведінку користувачів.

Про тебе:

- 2+ роки досвіду в продуктовій аналітиці.

- Досвід роботи з А/В-тестами: від гіпотези й дизайну експерименту до аналізу результатів і рішення.

- Просунуті навички SQL та впевнена робота з інструментами візуалізації даних.

- Впроваджував автоматизацію в аналітичних процесах за допомогою AI-інструментів.

- У тебе високий рівень автономності: сам доводиш задачу до результату - від першого запитання до висновку, яким можна користуватись.

- Ти проактивний: не чекаєш, поки тобі поставлять задачу, а й сам знаходиш точки росту й ініціюєш дослідження.

- В тебе сильні комунікативні навички й вміння пояснювати складні дані мовою бізнесу

Буде плюсом:

- Досвід роботи з транзакційною моделлю монетизації

title: Director, Social Media & Technical Communications
description:
ABOUT RADIANT

Radiant is looking for a senior social media and communications leader who can turn deep technical substance into public narrative, executive voice and market momentum.

The right candidate is a high-agency B2B technology storyteller: technically curious, editorially sharp, deeply fluent in social media, and resourceful enough to build a steady pipeline of speaking opportunities, conference submissions, podcast pitches, panels, awards, and executive visibility moments.

You should be comfortable operating in complex technical markets AI infrastructure, GPUs, datacenters, developer platforms, enterprise software or similar categories. You do not need to be an engineer, but you need to be able to sit with technical leaders, understand what matters, find the angle, and translate it into language that is sharp, credible, and useful.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

SOCIAL MEDIA STRATEGY & EXECUTION

You will own the company’s social presence across executive and corporate channels, with a particular focus on LinkedIn and other platforms where technical buyers, partners, investors, customers, and industry influencers spend time.

You will develop the strategy, write the content, shape the voice, test formats, track performance, and build a social engine that is sharp, intelligent, and distinctive. This includes company posts, executive posts, technical POVs, event coverage, launch support, partner amplification, customer moments, recruiting content, and timely commentary on industry developments.

EXECUTIVE VOICE & THOUGHT LEADERSHIP

You will help build and sharpen the public voices of the company’s executives and technical leaders. That means developing points of view, ghostwriting posts, preparing talking points, identifying timely angles, and turning internal conviction into external narrative.

TECHNICAL COMMUNICATIONS

You will work closely with product marketing, product, engineering, infrastructure, sales, partnerships and leadership to understand what the company is building and why it matters.

You will translate technical topics into clear, compelling communications for the market. This may include short-form social content, executive posts, speaking abstracts, event messaging, award submissions, customer stories, and thought-leadership themes.

You should know how to ask good questions, pressure-test claims, avoid hype, and make technical content accessible without making it shallow.

title: React Native Mobile Application Developer
description:
React Native Mobile Application Developer
Start Date: November 2026
Job Type: Full-Time
Labor Category: TECH
Location: Remote
Xentity is seeking to fill a React Native Mobile Application Developer position to lead the development and continued enhancement of mobile applications supporting the wildland fire community. The developer will be responsible for designing and implementing mobile experiences used by field personnel and fire management teams, with an emphasis on reliable operation in challenging environments where connectivity may be limited or unavailable.
The position will focus primarily on React Native mobile application development while also contributing to Xentity 's React-based web applications. The successful candidate will have hands-on experience developing and supporting at least one production mobile application that has been published to the Apple App Store or Google Play Store and will be able to demonstrate their specific development contributions to that application.
The developer will work extensively with React Native, offline application capabilities, local data storage, mobile mapping, and Esri ArcGIS technologies. The role requires an understanding of the complete mobile application lifecycle, including local development, testing, application configuration, signing, builds, and store submission processes. The developer will not be responsible for operating the mobile CI/CD deployment pipeline, but must have sufficient knowledge of mobile build and deployment processes to define requirements, troubleshoot issues, and effectively support the team responsible for mobile CI/CD.
Position Scope

• Lead the design and development of React Native mobile applications supporting wildland fire operations and field personnel.

• Develop mobile applications designed to operate reliably in remote and low-connectivity environments, including offline mapping and data capabilities.

• Implement mobile mapping functionality using Esri ArcGIS technologies, including maps, feature layers, geographic data, and offline workflows.

• Work closely with backend, GIS, and web application developers to integrate mobile applications with APIs, data services, and existing Xentity application platforms.

• Provide technical guidance to the mobile CI/CD team regarding application build requirements, environment configuration, signing, provisioning, testing, and App Store/Google Play release requirements.

• Troubleshoot mobile build, device, operating system, performance, connectivity, and application issues and work with the appropriate team members to resolve them.

• Help establish approaches for offline data storage, synchronization, caching, and recovery for field applications.

• Support application testing across iOS and Android devices and operating system versions.

• Work directly with product owners, project managers, GIS specialists, UX designers, and wildland fire subject matter experts to translate operational requirements into effective mobile solutions.

Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

• 3+ years of professional software development experience.

Required Requirements

• Must be US Citizen to meet government contract requirements

• Must be able to obtain and maintain a position of Public Trust clearance

• Demonstrated professional experience developing React Native mobile applications.

• Must have been a developer on one or more production mobile applications published to the Apple App Store or Google Play Store and be able to describe their specific development role and contributions.

• Strong experience with React Native and TypeScript.

• Experience developing mobile mapping applications and working with geospatial data in an offline or constrained-connectivity environment.

• Required experience with Esri ArcGIS technologies, including the ArcGIS Maps SDK for React Native or equiva

title: Mobile App Quality Control (QC) Tester - Remote (Indonesia)
description:
About the Role
We are looking for a Part-Time Mobile App Quality Control (QC) Tester based in Indonesia to support an ongoing project involving Android-based data capture technology.
In this role, you will help test and validate our mobile application across different Android devices, operating system versions, and real-world usage scenarios.
You will work closely with our international engineering and product teams to ensure the application performs reliably, accurately captures data, and provides a smooth user experience.
This role is ideal for individuals who are detail-oriented, comfortable using Android smartphones and Windows laptops, and interested in mobile application testing.
Key Responsibilities

• Install and configure testing software on Android devices and Windows laptops.

• Connect Android devices to laptops using a USB cable and execute guided testing scenarios.

• Perform functional testing across different Android devices and Android OS versions.

• Follow testing procedures provided by the engineering team to validate application functionality.

• Verify application behaviour, data capture accuracy, and overall system performance.

• Perform regression testing after bug fixes and application updates.

• Identify, document, and report bugs, issues, and observations in a clear and structured manner.

• Maintain accurate testing records and documentation.

• Participate in periodic review meetings with the engineering and product teams.

• Communicate testing findings and recommendations effectively.

Technical Requirements

• Comfortable using Android smartphones and Windows laptops.

• Basic understanding of mobile applications, software installation, and basic troubleshooting.

• Ability to follow detailed testing procedures accurately.

• Comfortable installing and using testing tools with guidance from the engineering team.

• Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking.

• Ability to reproduce issues consistently and document findings clearly.

Hardware Requirements

• Access to at least one Android smartphone (Samsung, Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo, Realme, Google Pixel, or equivalent).

• Access to a Windows laptop with a stable internet connection.

• Ability to connect an Android device to a laptop using a USB cable.

Preferred Qualifications

• Previous experience in Mobile App Testing, Software QA, Technical Support, Software Validation, UAT, or a related field is an advantage.

• Familiarity with bug reporting tools (JIRA, Azure DevOps, TestRail, Bugzilla, or similar) is preferred.

• Native or fluent Bahasa Indonesia communication skills.

• Basic to intermediate English communication skills (written and verbal) to collaborate with the international engineering team.

• Self-motivated, reliable, and able to work independently in a remote environment.

Time Commitment
Initial Setup & Intensive Testing Phase (First 3-4 Weeks)

• Approximately 20 hours per week

• Focus on application setup, device compatibility testing, validation, and issue identification.

Ongoing QC & Monitoring Phase

• Approximately 10 hours per week

• Routine testing, regression testing, validation of application updates, and issue monitoring.

What We're Looking For

• Detail-oriented and methodical.

• Comfortable working with technology and mobile applications.

• Able to work independently while following clear instructions.

• Reliable, responsible, and committed to meeting project timelines.

• Strong problem-solving and communication skills.

• Comfortable working remotely with an international team.

Why Join Us?

• Fully remote freelance opportunity.

• Flexible part-time working arrangement.

• Work with an international engineering and product team.

• Gain hands-on experience in Android mobile application quality testing.

• Immediate project start with a 6-month contract.
